description: This file contains assembly code generation for cryptographic functions related to GHASH, specifically optimized for SSSE3 instructions on x86_64 architecture. It includes functions for multiplication and hashing in GCM mode, with detailed comments on implementation strategies and bit manipulations.
external_methods: perl script invocation with x86_64-xlate.pl for translation

methods.name: gcm_gmult_ssse3
methods.description: Performs multiplication of a 128-bit value in GHASH using SSSE3 instructions, updating the input in place.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_ssse3
methods.description: Computes GHASH over a data input using precomputed table, updating the hash value.
